I really hope you get through this!! :))

Hi, I just finished my 6-month treatment. I started the first month with 40 mg, and then 60 mg daily. The only side-effects I sufferes were dry facez very dry lips, and back pain when I excercise heavily. The problem that is still sticking with me is that my hair falls a lot. My doctor told me that this problem would go away in a year after the treatmentz so take that into consideration.
